A day for each feast

Feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe

A Home Celebration for Our Lady of Guadalupe

Embrace the spirit of faith and community from home this Feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe, honoring traditions with delicious food and heartfelt reflection.

  1. Early Morning

    Mañanitas for Our Lady

    Begin your day by recreating the tradition of pilgrims serenading the Virgin. Play or sing "Las Mañanitas" or offer a special prayer at a home altar, setting a reverent tone.

  2. Morning

    Preparing the Savory Feast

    The Feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe is a day of abundant food. Start preparing savory dishes like tamales and pozole, filling your home with the festive aromas of Mexico.

    Recipes: Green Tamales (Tamales Verdes) · Cheese and Poblano Pepper Strip Tamales · Red Pozole

  3. Late Morning

    A Moment of Reflection with Roses

    While pilgrims offer roses at the basilica, you can place fresh roses before an image of Our Lady of Guadalupe at home, reflecting on her message of love and hope.

  4. Lunch

    First Course of Festive Delights

    Gather with family to savor the delicious tamales and pozole you prepared, a hearty and traditional way to celebrate the day's blessings.

    Recipes: Green Tamales (Tamales Verdes) · Cheese and Poblano Pepper Strip Tamales · Red Pozole · Crispy Chicken Tacos for the Feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe

  5. Afternoon

    Crafting Sweet Treats and Warm Drinks

    Get ready for the evening feast by making the traditional sweet treats and warm beverages that are central to Guadalupe celebrations, perfect for sharing later.

    Recipes: Buñuelos de Viento · Cinnamon Churros · Foamy Champurrado · Guava Atole

  6. Evening

    The Grand Dinner Celebration

    Enjoy a full meal featuring rich mole poblano, alongside crispy tacos and the freshly made desserts and drinks, celebrating the abundance and joy of the day.

    Recipes: Mole Poblano with Rice · Crispy Chicken Tacos for the Feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe · Buñuelos de Viento · Cinnamon Churros · Foamy Champurrado · Guava Atole

  7. Late Evening

    Sharing the Story of Juan Diego

    Conclude your day by reading or telling the story of Juan Diego and the apparitions, fostering a deeper connection to the festival's historical and spiritual significance.

May your home be filled with the warmth, faith, and delicious flavors of this special day.
